title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Corvette Z06
description:
The Chevrolet Corvette Z06 has the most powerful naturally aspirated V8 ever put in a production car, according to Chevrolet. Six hundred seventy horsepower, no turbos, no superchargers, and a redline of eight thousand six hundred r p m. But two facts about this car are almost never mentioned. One involves a wrecked Ferrari. The other is hidden inside every single engine. Here is the hint. To build this American engine, General Motors bought a crashed Italian supercar and took it apart. And when you open up a Z06 engine, you will find dozens of small symbols that have nothing to do with making power. Both stories are true, and both are documented.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
